notes.title: Devlog #2 – July Update & Chapter 3 Progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We’re Happy Slugs, the team behind Kill The Clock.

First of all, we want to sincerely apologize for not being able to finish some of the new features we had planned for this month.
As a two-person team, both of us were heavily involved in preparing for and attending BitSummit, an indie game festival held in Japan—and as a result, development was more disrupted than we expected.

That said, while we couldn’t complete new feature development, we’ve been actively fixing bugs as reports come in.
Also, progress on the Chapter 3 script is going smoothly, so we hope you're looking forward to it!

Here’s a breakdown of what we’ve been working on this month:
[hr][/hr]July Key Updates
Adjusted mouse offset

Fixed menu layout bugs in specific resolutions

Fixed input issues in certain languages

Corrected translation errors

Fixed minor animation/object bugs

Reduced the dialogue choice display when viewing the log

Fixed a bug where saving wasn’t possible on some chapter ending screens

Added a required interaction with a specific character in a specific scene
→ (This led to a new bug where the story could become blocked on Chapter 1, Day 3 if visited in a certain order — we released a hotfix in v0.5.15 to resolve this.)

Other minor bug fixes and polish
[hr][/hr]Chapter 3 Progress● Scenario & Script[olist]
Overall story flow and major plot planning – 🟢 Completed

Scene-by-scene structure, dialogue flow, and branching logic – 🟢 Completed (New!)

Writing full dialogue – 🟡 10% complete (New!)

Implementing the script in-game – ⚪ Not started
[/olist]● Art Assets[olist]
Investigation items and background art – 🟡 35% complete (New!)

Event CGs – ⚪ Not started

Ending CGs – ⚪ Not started
[/olist]
This month, we completed all scene-by-scene story structure and dialogue flow planning.
We’re now working on writing the actual dialogue for Day 1.

We’ve also begun creating art assets such as investigation items and background illustrations.
As of now, visuals for Day 1 and Day 2 are roughly complete.
Note: Some detailed item graphics may be adjusted later once the final script is ready.
[hr][/hr]Development Plans for August–September
Add controller support

Remove the "gift/bribe limit" from investigation scenes (except for initial character meetings)

Implement Steam Cloud Save

Improve how currency is earned

Continue bug fixes and stability improvements

Continue Chapter 3 dialogue writing

Create Chapter 3 investigation items, background art, and event CGs

To meet our timeline for Chapter 3, the top priority is completing the dialogue script.
However, since our lead programmer is also in charge of dialogue writing, it may take a bit longer for us to deliver new feature updates.

As always, bug fixes come first, so please don’t hesitate to send us reports anytime!
[hr][/hr]
We’re so grateful for all your support, which keeps us going even during the summer heat.
Please stay safe and cool—and thank you so much for your continued patience and encouragement.


— Team Happy Slugs 🐌

notes.title: Devlog #1 – June Update & Chapter 3 Progress
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We're Happy Slugs, the team behind Kill The Clock.

First of all, thank you so much for your incredible support and feedback since our Early Access launch on June 4!
We’ve received 21 steam reviews so far, along with many bug reports and suggestions through the Steam Community, Google Forms, email, and more. 

We’re carefully reading through each and every message, and while some fixes may take time, we’re working hard to address the most important issues first. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Major Updates This Month
Here's what we’ve updated in June:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846753/64380043c522b1a721b8b420529dd14e830e0247.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846753/ab0e38847d93f7b4f4ebc261f67d4cb1007e7cc2.png"]

Added more save slots

Added chapter select function

Improved UI and various features

Linked demo save files with the full game

Added friendship tutorial and dart minigame tutorial

Fixed achievement-related bugs

Fixed scene loading errors

Fixed various animation/object bugs

Corrected typos and translation issues

Fixed some resolution-related bugs

Other minor bug fixes and adjustments
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Chapter 3 Progress Report
Originally, we planned to start writing Chapter 3 right after launch.
However, we had to prioritize bug fixes and polish based on your feedback, so story development was slightly delayed.

Here’s how we structure our scenario development for chapter 3:
[olist]
Outline the overall story and plot – Completed

Plan detailed scene flow, dialogues, and branches – ~40% complete

Write the full script and direction notes

Implement the script into the game
[/olist]
We are currently in Step 2 and expect to begin full dialogue writing for chapter 3 next month.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ What’s Coming in July?
Here's what we’re working on next:

Add controller support

Improve how gold coins and resources are earned

Ongoing bug fixes and stabilization

Complete Chapter 3 planning and begin scriptwriting
[hr][/hr]
We promised to keep you updated regularly, and this is just the beginning.
We’ll continue sharing devlogs every month as we move toward the full release of Kill The Clock.

Thank you again for your support — every kind message, review, and piece of feedback truly means the world to us.

With love,
— Happy Slugs🐌

notes.title: 📢[Update Notice] Save Slot Expansion, Chapter Select, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've prioritized some of the most requested features and implemented the following major updates:
[hr][/hr]




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846753/64380043c522b1a721b8b420529dd14e830e0247.png"]You can now save up to 25 game files.
We hope this helps you experiment with different choices and story paths more freely!


[hr][/hr]




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846753/ab0e38847d93f7b4f4ebc261f67d4cb1007e7cc2.png"]You can now choose which chapter to start from when selecting New Game from the main menu.

📌 Please note:

You must have cleared at least one ending in Chapter 1 to unlock Chapter 2 selection.

If you skip Chapter 1 and start from Chapter 2, some experiences and settings from Chapter 1 will not carry over and will instead default to standard values.
(This may result in slightly unnatural monologue or story moments.)

However, you can manually choose which Chapter 1 ending to inherit when starting from Chapter 2, so you can still shape your story path to some extent.


[hr][/hr]


 Following the yesterday's patch, we’ve also fixed the following issues:

Fixed an issue where the dialogue box disappeared during certain scenes in Chapter 2.

Adjusted the skip function to stop properly when entering Chapter 2.

Fixed a bug where your gold unexpectedly changed to 100G during Chapter 1.

Fixed an issue where the navigation arrow was hard to see in the pub.

Fixed a bug where the wrong affinity icon was shown when rolling dice against Victoria.

 Achievement-related Fixes:

Fixed: "Game Addict" achievement not triggering in Chapter 2.

Fixed: Victoria’s affinity achievement not unlocking.

Fixed: Dice Game achievements for Highest/Lowest Roll not functioning properly.


[hr][/hr]


We’re closely monitoring Steam reviews, bug reports, and all posts on the community hub.
Your feedback is helping us make Kill The Clock better with each update. Thank you so much!

We are still working on additional fixes and features, so please stay tuned for future updates.



Thank you again for your continued support!



– Happy Slugs

notes.title: 🕰️ Kill The Clock – Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,
We're excited to announce that Kill The Clock has officially launched in Early Access on Steam! 🎉

You can now play through Chapter 1 and Chapter 2, where the mystery begins to unfold through time loops, investigation, and dice-based decisions.


🔎 What’s Available in Early Access?
- Full access to Chapter 1 & 2
- Character customization + stat-based choice system
- Time-loop mechanics begin


🗺️ What’s Next?
- Chapter 3 Update planned for December 2025
- Chapter 4 & Full Release scheduled for June 2026


We’ll also be sharing monthly devlogs to keep you updated on our progress and upcoming content!

If you enjoy the game, consider leaving a Steam review — it helps a lot and motivates our tiny team to keep going! 

Thanks again, and see you in the loop! ⏳

— Happy Slugs

notes.title: [Launch Date Update]
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We’d like to inform you that the release date for Kill The Clock has been changed from May 26 to June 4.

Most of the preparations have been completed, but we identified the need for final adjustments related to the Steam achievement system. Since Steam’s build review process can take up to five business days—and additional revisions may be required—we’ve decided to shift the release date slightly to ensure everything is in place.

We sincerely apologize for the delay and thank you for your patience and understanding. We’re doing our best to deliver a more polished experience at launch.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Important Update: Game Name Change to 'Kill The Clock'
notes.content:
Dear valued members of our community,

We have an important announcement to share with you regarding a recent change.

Previously known as 'Counter Clock Case,' we've decided to rename our game to 'Kill The Clock.' This change comes after discovering that a well-known podcast titled 'CounterClock' exists, focusing on time travel criminal justice, with the term 'counterclock' being trademarked. Despite our efforts to reach out to the podcast's creators for permission to use a similar name, unfortunately, we haven't received a response.

In order to avoid any potential trademark infringement and future complications, we've made the decision to proactively change the name at this early stage of development.

I'm writing this announcement because I understand that some of you might be surprised by this sudden change. Despite this alteration, our team is working diligently and we're on track to release a demo later this month. 

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. We appreciate your patience as we navigate these changes, and we look forward to sharing more updates with you soon.

Best regards,

Happy Slugs
